subject: Next steps: Northbridge pilot KPI sprint & measurement plan
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sam Hayes <sam.hayes@northbridge.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Northbridge pilot — recap + proposed KPI sprint

Hi Sam — thanks again for the call earlier. Nice to meet you and the Northbridge team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the trial: 

Summary of ask
- Evaluate Redwood for a document ingestion + summarization step in your analytics pipeline (batch inference + low-latency lookups for 1M monthly queries).
- Key concerns: latency under 250ms p50 for short queries (<=64 tokens), end-to-end throughput during peak (>=800 qps sustained), and cost target ~ $0.0018/token for generator paths.

Proposed POC goals (draft)
1) Latency: p50 <= 250ms, p95 <= 600ms for 64-token queries (measured at Northbridge edge).
2) Throughput: sustain 800 qps with <5% error rate for 5-minute windows.
3) Cost: baseline cost per token <= $0.0018 for generation path; measure with Redwood Optimize suggested quantization + batching.
4) Quality: extractive summary F1 >= 0.78 against the pilot test set (we'll provide 500 labeled items) AND manual quality check pass rate >= 85% on pilot prompts.

Ownership & timeline
- Northbridge will: provide sample dataset (500 labeled items), security questionnaire answers, and a procurement contact (procure@northbridge.ai) by Oct 6.
- Redwood will: provide a measurement template, deploy a private trial endpoint in your preferred region, and share an evaluation runbook by Oct 9.
- Proposed cadence: kickoff week of Oct 12, two-week sprint for smoke + performance runs, one-week QA/readout week. Deliverables: measurement report, cost estimate, recommendations.

Attachments: I attached a lightweight measurement template (nb-pilot-measurement-template.xlsx) and a one-page scope doc (redwood-poc-scope.pdf).

Can you confirm the timeline and whether the procurement contact above is correct? If that looks good I'll schedule the kickoff invite and loop in infra for private endpoint provisioning.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0127

From: Sam Hayes <sam.hayes@northbridge.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 16:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Northbridge pilot — recap + proposed KPI sprint

Monica — thanks for the clear notes and the docs. Confirming procurement is procure@northbridge.ai (Procurement Team). We'll aim to get the 500 labeled items and questionnaire back by Tue Oct 6. A couple clarifying points: 

1) For latency: our traffic pattern is a mix of short read queries (~70%) and longer context queries (~30%). Can Redwood measure latency by query class separately (short v long)? We care about the short-query SLA primarily.
2) Throughput: 800 qps sustained is our target during business hours; overnight bursts may hit 1.2k briefly. We don't expect full-night sustained load.
3) Cost: procurement will want a tiered estimate (hosted vs dedicated) for the expected monthly token volume — is that something you can surface in the Oct 9 report?

If you can include a short script or curl examples for how we'll measure p50/p95 from our side that would be helpful. Otherwise, the timeline looks good. Please go ahead and schedule the kickoff for Oct 13 (10am PT) if that works for you.

Best,
Sam Hayes
Northbridge Analytics
sam.hayes@northbridge.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sam Hayes <sam.hayes@northbridge.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Northbridge pilot — recap + proposed KPI sprint

Sam — appreciate the detail. Quick technical clarifications and measurement plan so we're aligned before kickoff: 

Measurement approach (high level) - We'll provide a small benchmark harness (node/python) that issues mixed traffic according to the ratios you called out (70/30). Harness will report p50/p95, error rate, and per-token billing counts. 
- We'll include two workload profiles: short-query (<=64 tokens request, 64 token generation cap) and long-query (<=512 tokens request, 256 token generation cap).

Success gates (proposal)
- Perf: p50 short-query <= 250ms AND sustained throughput >=800 qps with error rate <5% for 5-minute windows. If either misses we flag as "needs tuning" and run a second optimization pass (quantization + batch tuning).
- Cost: We'll run both hosted and dedicated estimates; initial cost calc will assume your monthly volume X (you can confirm exact expected monthly QPS).
- Quality: We'll compute automated F1 and sample 50 human-eval passes. If automated metrics fall within 0.05 of target we'll consider it acceptable pending manual review.

Items we'll need from Northbridge before kickoff
1) Exact monthly query estimate (or sample hour) for hosted vs peak.
2) The 500 labeled items in CSV with columns: id, source_text, gold_summary.
3) A contact in infra (for private endpoint networking) if you're choosing private.

I'll add the lightweight harness link to the kickoff notes and make sure Redwood infra can provision the trial endpoint within 48 hours of kickoff.

Thanks — looping in Rishi for the cost/quantization plan.

--
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sam Hayes <sam.hayes@northbridge.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Northbridge pilot — recap + proposed KPI sprint

Sam / Monica / Ben — quick note on cost modeling and owners. I'll own the cost and quantization recommendations during the sprint. Preliminary guidance: for mixed workloads we expect a ~25-40% cost reduction from int8 quantization plus continuous batching (workload dependent). For the Oct 9 report I'll include: 
- Hosted estimate (tokens/month -> $; tiered price bands)
- Dedicated estimate (committed capacity cost and break-even point)
- Sensitivity table (how cost changes with avg tokens per request and batching window)

Action items for kickoff (owners) - Northbridge: send dataset + monthly QPS estimate + procurement confirmation (Sam / procurement).
- Redwood (Monica): schedule kickoff (Oct 13 10am PT) and confirm infra region.
- Redwood (Ben): share harness and measurement steps before Oct 9.
- Redwood (Rishi): include cost sensitivity and recommended quantization profile in the Oct 9 deliverable.

I'll attach a short example curl and the measurement commands in the kickoff invite. Looking forward to starting.

Rgds,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Solutions Architecture | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
